name: Typical Timeline for a Permitted Central AC Installation in Los Angeles County

mainEntity.name: What is the realistic total timeline for a permitted central AC installation in Los Angeles County, from first estimate to final inspection?
mainEntity.text: What is the realistic total timeline for a permitted central AC installation in Los Angeles County, from first estimate to final inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a typical single‑family home in Los Angeles County, the complete timeline for a permitted central AC installation is longer than just the install day. From first estimate to final inspection, most projects run 2–6 weeks, depending on your city and contractor schedule. The first 1–2 weeks are usually consumed by in‑home assessments, system design, and securing city or county permits once you approve a proposal. The actual installation, including setting the condenser, installing or modifying ductwork, wiring, and startup, usually takes 1–3 days of onsite work. Complex duct changes, attic access issues, or asbestos abatement can extend this. After installation, your contractor will schedule required inspections and, if applicable, HERS testing for duct leakage, airflow, or refrigerant charge. Inspection timing varies significantly by jurisdiction within Los Angeles County. Some cities can send an inspector within a few days; others may take 1–3 weeks in busy seasons. If the inspector requests corrections, your contractor must return, make the fixes, and schedule a re‑inspection, adding a few more days. When planning around heat waves, vacations, or tenants, use the full 2–6 week window rather than just the installation date.
acceptedAnswer.description: A fully permitted central AC installation in Los Angeles County typically takes 2–6 weeks from first estimate to final inspection. One to two weeks cover estimates and permitting, 1–3 days for installation, and 1–3 weeks for inspection scheduling and any required corrections, depending on your city’s backlog and contractor availability.
